# UWAZI

> Nonpartisan, AI-powered civic intelligence platform. UWAZI helps people learn how their government works, track legislation, research candidates, and build a voting plan — all in one place.

UWAZI is a 501(c)(3) civic education project. It pairs a Duolingo-style lesson system with an AI assistant ("Ask Uwazi"), localized legislation and election tracking, and a community impact leaderboard for partner organizations.

## Pages

- [Welcome](/welcome): Product overview, key features, and how UWAZI works.
- [Impact](/impact): Public leaderboard of partner organizations driving civic engagement.
- [Join](/join): Accept a partner organization invite and create an account.
